temporal_state_chain.observed: Ethan notices Gary has been working excessively long hours at the hospital, often skipping meals and sacrificing sleep. In their conversation, Gary declines Ethan's invitation to a weekend retreat because there is too much to do at the hospital.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan believes Gary is dedicated but is overworking to the point that his health is at risk, and that Gary may need an intervention to rest and recover.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: No fundamental change; Gary's refusal confirms that his hospital workload is a serious obstacle and that his sense of obligation may be preventing him from accepting help.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Gary is overworking and at risk, and his hospital responsibilities are so pressing that he initially refuses an opportunity to relax.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To keep trying to help Gary address his overwork and health, either by persuading him again or finding another way to support him.

temporal_state_chain.observed: During the retreat, Ethan observes Gary acting restless and avoiding discussions about work. This makes Ethan suspect there is more behind Gary's overworking than just professional obligations.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan believes Gary is overworked and at health risk, and although Gary initially resisted help, they are now at the retreat, so Ethan hopes Gary may be open to relaxing.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; Ethan shifts from seeing Gary's overwork as primarily professional to suspecting deeper or complicated personal reasons behind it.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Gary's overworking likely has hidden causes beyond ordinary hospital obligations, and Gary may be carrying burdens he has not shared.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To confront Gary gently and nonjudgmentally, offering support so Gary can open up about what is really wrong.

temporal_state_chain.observed: After the confrontation, Gary opens up about the pressures of managing a new department and the personal challenges he is facing.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan suspects Gary is hiding deeper problems behind his overwork and wants to understand what is really going on.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; Ethan's suspicion is replaced by a clearer understanding of Gary's specific pressures and personal difficulties.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Gary is overwhelmed by both new departmental responsibilities and personal challenges, but with help he can find a better work-life balance.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To help Gary find better balance by prioritizing tasks, delegating responsibilities, and organizing his schedule.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Over the following months, Ethan regularly checks in with Gary and hears about his progress and remaining challenges. Gary reports feeling less overwhelmed and even had time for a movie last weekend.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan believes Gary is working toward better balance after opening up, but may still struggle with old pressures and challenges.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; Ethan sees evidence that Gary's efforts are producing real, ongoing improvement.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Gary is making meaningful progress, is becoming less overwhelmed, and is receptive to Ethan's support and encouragement.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To continue checking in with Gary, offering encouragement, and being available whenever Gary needs to talk.

temporal_state_chain.observed: After a year, Gary has successfully adjusted to a healthier work-life balance. Gary thanks Ethan and says he feels more in control now.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan believes Gary has been improving but may still benefit from periodic support and check-ins.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; Ethan now sees that Gary has successfully adjusted and is capable of managing his work-life balance on his own.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Gary no longer needs active intervention from Ethan and can maintain his healthier balance independently, though Ethan remains available if needed.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Satisfied and happy for his friend
temporal_state_chain.intention: To step back from active support while letting Gary know he is always just a call away if anything changes.
